root_cause_analysis.issue: EventsPage.js does not use dynamic terminology from ModulesContext
details: The page uses hardcoded strings and LanguageContext translations (t() function)
It does NOT import useModules() from ModulesContext
The default engagement_type is always 'event' regardless of industry
Should use getProgramOrchestrationConfig() to get entity labels
fix_required: Set default engagement_type based on isProfessionalServices
Replace hardcoded 'events' text with dynamic terminology
